Bill.BriefDescription: Including goats in theft of livestock in the first degree.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to theft of or damage to livestock; amending RCW9A.56.080 and 4.24.320; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.56.080 and 2003 c 53 s 74 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every person who, with intent to sell or exchange and todeprive or defraud the lawful owner thereof, willfully takes, leads, ortransports away, conceals, withholds, slaughters, or otherwiseappropriates any horse, mule, cow, heifer, bull, steer, swine, goat, orsheep is guilty of theft of livestock in the first degree. (2) Theft of livestock in the first degree is a class B felony.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.320 and 2003 c 53 s 4 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who suffers damages as a result of actions described inRCW ((9A.48.080(c))) 16.52.205 or any owner of a horse, mule, cow,heifer, bull, steer, swine, goat, or sheep who suffers damages as aresult of a willful, unauthorized act described in RCW 9A.56.080 or p. 1 SSB 52909A.56.083 may bring an action against the person or persons committingthe act in a court of competent jurisdiction for exemplary damages upto three times the actual damages sustained, plus attorney's fees.
